# Every file this fork changes against upstream's main. .github/scripts/check-fork-allowlist.sh
# fails on a changed file not listed here, and on a line the fork no longer changes. A line ending
# in / is a directory the fork owns. Add a file here in the same change that first edits it.

# The fork's own web app, beside upstream's, outside the root workspaces, and the envoy image
# that adds it to upstream's.
packages/tl-dispatch/
.github/workflows/fork-envoy-image.yaml
.github/scripts/fork-envoy-base.sh

# The fork's checks.
.github/fork-allowlist.txt
.github/scripts/check-fork-allowlist.sh
.github/workflows/fork-checks.yaml

# The weekly sync from upstream.
.github/scripts/fork-sync.sh
.github/scripts/fork-sync.test.sh
.github/workflows/fork-sync.yaml
.github/workflows/fork-sync-test.yaml
.github/scripts/check-image-trigger-paths.sh

# The fork's own image line: no upstream release numbers.
.github/workflows/fork-worker-image.yaml
.github/workflows/release-envoy-listener.yaml

# A fix not yet upstream.
packages/daemon/internal/ghbranch/ghbranch.go
packages/daemon/internal/ghbranch/ghbranch_test.go
